_comment: Editorial, hand-maintained U.S. national comparison series — same maintenance pattern as breaks.json. Verify against the cited NCES tables at each refresh and extend when NCES publishes new actuals (they lag DPI by 1-3 years; that gap is disclosed in the methodology footer). Only metrics with genuinely comparable national definitions belong here: graduation uses the same EDFacts 4-year ACGR methodology Wisconsin reports into, and enrollment is used only for the indexed percent-change view. ACT is deliberately absent (Wisconsin census-tests every 11th-grader; the published national ACT average covers self-selected graduating-class test-takers — not comparable). Chronic absenteeism is deliberately absent (federal CRDC counts students missing >=15 days; Wisconsin's rate is percentage-of-enrolled-days based — different definitions).

grad_rate_4yr.source: NCES, Digest of Education Statistics 2023, table 219.46 (U.S. public high school 4-year adjusted cohort graduation rate; 2010-11 value from the Digest 2022 edition of the same table). Values as published, whole percent. Parsed from the United States row of the published tables 2026-07-25.

total_enrollment.source: NCES, Digest of Education Statistics 2023, table 203.10 (total fall enrollment in U.S. public elementary and secondary schools). Actual years only — the table's projected years (fall 2023 onward in that edition) are excluded. Published in thousands; stored here as students.
